messages:
sam: Heads up: a customer hit a weird billing case. Stream reconnect + toolcall truncation caused duplicate token charge.

lee: Any trace ids?

sam: trace=xyz789, session=session-42. Client reconnected mid-stream, server completed a toolcall after resume but we billed both the pre-truncation and post-resume suffix.

Priya: Do we currently dedupe by toolcall_id or only by session + timestamps?

lee: router emits toolcall_id sometimes, but not always (older SDKs). Ledger dedupe relies on exact toolcall_id match.

sam: proposed quick fix: if reconnect detected within GRACE_WINDOW and prompt-prefix matches, mark resumed tokens provisional. Backfill or reverse in reconcile job.

Priya: Nice. Telemetry needs a flag: provisional_reason={reconnect,truncation,retry}. Also add provisional_tokens to billing export.

lee: Implementation plan: 1) router: emit X-Client-Session header; 2) ledger: accept provisional marks and queue reconcile job; 3) console: show provisional vs confirmed.

ops-bot: reconcile-job scheduled (cron: */1 * * * *).

sam: UX ask: console should default to showing smoothed charges (blend provisional) with option to toggle raw events.

Priya: Add alert if provisional/confirmed ratio > 0.2 for any customer in 10m window.

lee: I'll prototype router tag and a reconcile worker. ETA 48h.

sam: I'll draft a support note and temporary credit playbook.

Priya: looping in billing after lee prototype.

sam: keeping thread for quick trace snippets.
